code='''def transform(grid):
    rows = len(grid)
    cols = len(grid[0])
    cross_rows = [r for r in range(rows) if all(grid[r][c] == 3 for c in range(cols))]
    cross_cols = [c for c in range(cols) if all(grid[r][c] == 3 for r in range(rows))]
    hr, vc = cross_rows[0], cross_cols[0]
    out = []
    for r in range(rows):
        row = []
        for c in range(cols):
            if r == hr or c == vc:
                row.append(3)
            else:
                row.append(4 if max(abs(r - hr), abs(c - vc)) % 2 == 0 else 0)
        out.append(row)
    return out
'''
